18.name: Auditions: Group 1
18.overview: MasterChef Australia returns with auditions and 40 of the country's best home cooks are ready. Tonight 20 cooks have 90 minutes to cook their dream dish in order to win one of the 10 aprons on offer.

18.name: Auditions: Group 2
18.overview: Another 20 home cooks enter the MasterChef kitchen to compete for 10 aprons on offer. For those who miss out, they learn there will be one final chance to cook for the last four aprons tomorrow.

18.name: Auditions: Second Chance
18.overview: Tonight, the 20 remaining hopefuls have a second and final chance to cook their way into the competition. Just who will score themselves one of the final four places?

18.name: Mystery Box: Jimmy Barnes
18.overview: Aussie Rock legend Jimmy Barnes set this season's first mystery box, inspiring the Top 24 with seasonal ingredients they love to cook with. Dish of the day will see its maker safe from elimination.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Family Favourites
18.overview: In the first elimination of the competition, 23 cooks will show the judges a window into their homelife, through a favourite dish that they cook at home for their loved ones.

18.name: Invention Test: Cereal
18.overview: It's the return of a MasterChef classic with an Invention Test challenging cooks to create an inventive dish using cereal.

18.name: Pressure Test: Maggie Beer
18.overview: The bottom five cooks from the Invention Test face off in a Pressure Test set by MasterChef favourite Maggie Beer, tasked with mastering her signature sour cream pastry in a high-stakes pie challenge.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Andy Cooks
18.overview: It's Family Favourites week and social media sensation Andy Cooks (chef Andy Hearnden) is on the hunt for the ultimate breakfast, in an immunity challenge cook with 60 minutes on the clock.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Reinventing Carbs
18.overview: In an elimination challenge centred on reinventing the judges' quick carb midweek dinner recipes, mistakes and time pressure sends one cook home.

18.name: Team Challenge: Family Feast
18.overview: It is the first team challenge of the series, and the contestants are all eager to see how well they can work together. The bottom two teams will find themselves in the elimination the following day.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Family Traditions
18.overview: Six contestants face elimination as they must create a dish that represent their family food traditions to fight for their place in the competition.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Catherine Zhang
18.overview: The Top 20 compete for Immunity from tomorrow's Elimination in a fruity Mystery Box challenge set by Catherine Zhang, marking the start of Viral Wonders Week

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Viral Ingredients
18.overview: Viral sensation Victoria Minell (aka @recipesbyvictoria) sets a challenge to use one of her five viral ingredients in a 75-minute cook to save their place in the competition

18.name: Team Service Challenge: Viral-worthy Dish
18.overview: Six teams will compete in their first service challenge, tasked with creating one perfect viral-worthy dish to serve to hundreds of diners, and impress a mystery social media-star critic

18.name: Immunity Pin Challenge: Khanh Ong
18.overview: MasterChef alum and social media star Khanh Ong sets an epic challenge to create a bold, out-there sandwich with a banging cross section, to win the first immunity pin of the season

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Rick Stein
18.overview: It's the start of Around the World Week, and global food icon Rick Stein joins the MasterChef Kitchen to set an extra spicy Mystery Box challenge

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Cuisines from Around the World
18.overview: In an Around the World elimination challenge, MasterChef contestants must create a dish inspired by a chosen cuisine, featuring a surprise hero ingredient revealed only after they commit

18.name: Invention Test: Fusion
18.overview: It's a fusion invention test today with the contestants having to make dish featuring cuisines from two countries

18.name: Pressure Test: Rosheen Kaul
18.overview: Chef Rosheen Kaul sets the first full Pressure Test for the season, with an intense, three-hour challenge

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Dim Sim Lim
18.overview:
Kicking off nostalgia-themed week in the MasterChef kitchen, social media sensation chef Dim Sim Lim sets a 60-minute mystery box challenge requiring a steamed element.

English

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Heritage
18.overview: The MasterChef contestants must cook something connected to their heritage to avoid being eliminated.

18.name: Team Challenge: Team Relay
18.overview: In MasterChef's most notorious team challenge, four teams will navigate the chaos of the Team Relay to compete for a chance to cook for Immunity.

18.name: Immunity Pin Challenge: French Techniques
18.overview: Guided by MasterChef Alumna Justine Schofield, four contestants put their French techniques to the test for a chance to win a coveted immunity pin.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Matt Sinclair & Daniel Dobra
Invention Test: Reese's Peanut Butter Cup
Mystery Box Challenge: Curtis Stone
18.overview: Curtis Stone kicks off Aussie Classics week, with a once-in-a-lifetime chance for the cooks to have their dish stocked in Coles, as they are challenged to whip up nostalgic Pie and Ice-cream flavours.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Pork
18.overview: With Curtis Stone back in the kitchen, the MasterChef contestants are challenged with cooking a dish that features pork to save their place in the competition.

18.name: Comeback Challenge
18.overview: It's Aussie Classics Week, and there's nothing Aussies love more than a great comeback story. Today, the previously eliminated contestants return for a chance to earn their place back in the competition.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Aussie Native Ingredients
18.overview: Aussie Classics week draws to a close with an exciting day in the MasterChef Kitchen as guest judge and Aussie icon Robert Irwin sets an Aussie Native Ingredients Elimination Challenge.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Adriano Zumbo
18.overview: It's the start of Sweet Week, and confectionery king Adriano Zumbo challenges the cooks to hero a mystery ingredient in a dessert. The top three dishes will win immunity from tomorrow's elimination.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Ice Cream Taste Test
18.overview: As Sweet Week continues, the contestants take part in an Ice Cream Taste Test. The first four who guess incorrectly will land in the Round Two cook, after which someone will be sent home.

18.name: Invention Test: Air Fryer
18.overview: It's Sweet Week, and today's challenge is an Air Fryer Invention Test, with the top four dishes going into tomorrow's Immunity Challenge. Dish of the day will claim a $5,000 Harvey Norman voucher!

18.name: Immunity Pin Challenge: Beat the Chef
18.overview: On Sweet Week's final day, four contestants face dessert powerhouse Jess Lemon in a 'Beat the Chef' Immunity Pin challenge, attempting to outcook one of the MasterChef kitchen's pastry prodigies.

18.name: Skills Challenge: Fish Butchery
18.overview: To kick off Masters Week, industry icon Josh Niland gives a fish butchery masterclass, and the contestants must use one of his signature butchery techniques to prepare flathead in 75 minutes.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Flat Iron Steak
18.overview: Masters Week continues with Michelin-starred chef Curtis Stone returning to the MasterChef kitchen for a high-stakes elimination where contestants must hero a flat iron steak.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Tom Sarafian
18.overview: Masters Week continues as hatted Melbourne chef Tom Sarafian joins to showcase his famous hummus dish, inspiring contestants to make an immunity-worthy dish to get one step closer to the Top 10.

18.name: Pressure Test: Kirsten Tibballs
18.overview: In the final Masters Week challenge, four contestants compete in a pressure test set by Kirsten Tibballs to avoid elimination and secure their place in the Top 10.

18.name: Twins Challenge
18.overview: It's Knockout Week, and our 10 cooks face the iconic twins challenge inspired by MasterChef couple Sarah Todd and Declan Cleary and their identical twin girls, Charlotte and Claudia.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: The Judge's Fridge
18.overview: As Knockout Week continues, the MasterChef judges have each filled a fridge with ingredients. Eight contestants must choose a fridge, without looking inside, and use its contents to make a dish.

18.name: Team Challenge: Fine Dining
18.overview: It's Knockout Week, and two teams of three, led by Andy and Jean-Christophe, must deliver a two-course fine dining menu for 16 Coles Farmers. The losing team will head into tomorrow's elimination.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Ingredient Choice
18.overview: It's Knockout week and the first elimination for the Top 10. The seven contestants cooking must feature an ingredient chosen by one of their fellow cooks to keep their place in the competition.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Sanjeev Kapoor
18.overview: Our Top 9 contestants welcome one of the most famous chefs in India, with over 150 cookbooks and 20 million social media followers, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor, who is here to set a Mystery Box.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: International Ingredients
18.overview: Contestants must produce a dish featuring one of five internationally sourced ingredients that they have never used before, in an elimination cook-off. For one cook, it will be their final dish.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Ice Cream Flavours
18.overview: The top eight of MasterChef Australia get to select a Connoisseur ice cream to start the day. Cooking for immunity, they must cook a dessert inspired by their ice cream flavour.

18.name: Pressure Test: Sam Aisbett
18.overview: In a high-stakes pressure test featuring Michelin-starred Chef Sam Aisbett's 'Crab Salad', four contestants must navigate complex technical components and personal errors to avoid elimination.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: Marion Grasby
18.overview: To mark the start of Heat Week, food and media mogul Marion Grasby returns to MasterChef for the first time in 16 years with a spicy mystery box challenge.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Hot New Chilli Dish
18.overview: Heat Week continues with a looming elimination as six of the seven remaining cooks are challenged to create a hot new chilli dish in just 60 minutes.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Hibachi
18.overview: Five cooks must prove their skill and creativity using only a hibachi, with the winner earning immunity and a spot in the Top 6.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Head-to-Head Duels
18.overview: It's the final day of HEAT WEEK, and four cooks face off in head-to-head duals in an elimination challenge. After two rounds of battle, the bottom dish in the final duel will send its maker home.

18.name: Mystery Box Challenge: One Ingredient
18.overview: Contestants must choose a mystery box set by Sofia containing just one ingredient. Using just that and under-bench staples, the best dish wins immunity and the first spot in the Top 5.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: French Sauces
18.overview: With a coveted place in the Top 5 of MasterChef 2026 at stake, contestants must personalise a classic French sauce, as demonstrated by Jean-Christophe. For one cook, it will be the end of the line.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Keeping Up With Andy
18.overview: It's an immunity challenge today for the Top 5 to 'Keep up with Andy' as he cooks his delicious BBQ Lamb, Burnt Eggplant Cream, and Braised Borlotti Beans dish. The top cook will go directly into the Top 4.

18.name: Pressure Test: Malaysian Snacks
18.overview: Four of the Top 5 contestants battle it out to stay in the competition, taking on an epic pressure test set by judge Poh Ling Yeow to recreate three of her beautiful and delicious Malaysian snacks.

18.name: Immunity Challenge: Meghan Markle
18.overview: The Duchess of Sussex, Meghan Markle, joins the MasterChef Australia kitchen today, offering some of her favourite seasonal produce to feature in a heartfelt dish, with immunity on the line.

18.name: Elimination Challenge: Letters From Home
18.overview: It's elimination day, and there are two spots up for grabs in the semi-final. Emotions run high when letters and ingredients from home inspire our cooks to make a dish to keep them in the competition.

18.name: Judges vs. Contestants
18.overview: Today's challenge is a MasterChef classic. First, the tables are turned, and the judges cook off head-to-head before teaming up to take on the Top 3 contestants, with bragging rights on the line.

18.name: Semi Final: Two-course Service Challenge
18.overview: In today's Semi-Final, the Top 3 contestants will battle it out in a two-course service challenge, each cooking for more than 20 diners. By the end of the day, we will have our two Grand Finalists.

18.name: Grand Finale
18.overview: After months of cooking in the MasterChef kitchen, it comes down to this. Our two finalists arrive at the Grand Finale, where they will battle it out for the title of MasterChef champion 2026.

overview: MasterChef Australia is a Logie Award-winning Australian competitive cooking game show based on the original British MasterChef. It is produced by Shine Australia and screens on Network Ten.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview:
Jock Zonfrillo, Melissa Leong and Andy Allen take the helm of the show that celebrates food and the love of food.

Jock, Melissa and Andy will be joined in the MasterChef Australia kitchen by a delicious assortment of the world’s best chefs, including Gordon Ramsay, Heston Blumenthal and Curtis Stone, to serve up the 12th helping of MasterChef Australia. The traditional MasterChef Australia recipe also boasts some new ingredients when the best of the best from the past 11 seasons return to the kitchen in MasterChef Australia – Back To Win.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview:
Judges Jock Zonfrillo, Melissa Leong and Andy Allen are back in the MasterChef Australia kitchen, ready to introduce the next generation of exceptional home cooks. 2021 will be seasoned to perfection with some of the world’s most recognisable and beloved chefs including Nigella Lawson, Yotam Ottolenghi, Heston Blumenthal, Massimo Bottura and Clare Smyth - plus homegrown sensations including Curtis Stone, Kirsten Tibballs, Darren Purchese, Alla Wolf-Tasker, Scott Pickett, Poh Ling Yeow, Callum Hann and Reynold Poernomo, all set to challenge the top 24 contestants.

Sacrificing everything to follow their food dreams, this season’s passionate contestants have put their lives on hold to be part of this life-changing experience. With heart, soul and drive, this season’s exceptional contestants will follow their food dreams and make magic happen.

seasons.name: Fans & Favourites
seasons.overview:
Jock Zonfrillo, Andy Allen and Melissa Leong return to judge Season 14 of MasterChef Australia: Fans & Favourites.

Original champion Julie Goodwin leads the 12 returning cooks who compete alongside 12 newcomers (and no auditions). The MasterChef kitchen also once again plays host to chefs from Australia and overseas, including Adriano Zumbo, Shannon Bennet, Curtis Stone, Reynold Poernomo, Clare Smyth, Alla Wolf-Tasker, Josh Niland and Maggie Beer.

seasons.name: Secrets & Surprises
seasons.overview:
Returning for its 15th season, MasterChef Australia is back to deliver a series full of twists and turns with Secrets & Surprises.

Originally scheduled to premiere 1 May 2023, the series was postponed due to the sudden passing of judge Jock Zonfrillo the night before.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: This season feature 4 judges. Andy Allen, Sofia Levin, Jean-Christophe Novelli and Poh Ling Yeow. The number of contestants increased from 18 to 22. Like the previous 2 seasons, the season omitted the broadcast of the audition stage. Only one Immunity Pin is up for grabs this season.

seasons.name: Back to Win
seasons.overview: The seventeenth series of the Australian television cooking show MasterChef Australia was announced on 16 September 2024. The series features the same four judges as series 16, namely series 4 winner Andy Allen, food writer Sofia Levin, French chef Jean-Christophe Novelli and series 1 runner-up Poh Ling Yeow. Similar to series 12, the 2025 series features a Back to Win concept, with 24 contestants from previous seasons returning for a chance to win the title.
